name: Citrus guild 1 (proposed)
notes: Team: plant guilds to support the mature citrus. Claude: comfrey, lemongrass and pigeon pea at the drip line; garlic chives, nasturtium, native violet, calendula, yarrow, sweet alyssum under; white clover in gaps; 30 cm mulch-free ring at the trunk. (Positions are indicative, traced from the team's bubble plan onto the aerial; check on site.)
